transformers_pil_bicubic.description: checkpoint's Transformers processor default: PIL bicubic resize to 448

model_card_bilinear_no_antialias_torch_c.description: 448px bilinear resize, antialias disabled, half-pixel coordinates and uint8 quantization; PyTorch-compatible implementation because TensorFlow is unavailable
model_card_bilinear_no_antialias_torch_c.difference_from_model_card: resize engine is PyTorch rather than tf.image.resize

official_evidence_gap.reason: MedSigLIP's model card reports other private/unspecified medical evaluation tasks; it does not publish a same-checkpoint PCam reference and complete PCam protocol

user_decision: When no public same-protocol metric exists, retain the RTX 4090 result as a self-defined stage-one engineering baseline with an explicit note
